test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 1 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the sixth term is related to the fifth term.

INSTEAD ∶ NISTEDA ∶∶ JUSTICE ∶ ? ∶∶ LIBERAL ∶ ILBERLA
solution:
The positional values of English alphabet is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0feadec6334417d48300e8b565d1c1d9e73015cad02726ea6b55b6976b18ed05.png] 

INSTEAD is written as 'NISTEDA'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36fb22aaab855f157d8e139756f81b06da20925ce59d22de13e74f863b0a9dec.png] 

LIBERAL is written as 'ILBERLA'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f284a0a93ddeb412f22ae949377085ba5e9a0e681e193b98568c236402c860e.png] 

Similarly, JUSTICE is written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5ea35f07a0526b3f6aff1a24b0bf9c7389cd4feb849ae6bd113c6de6568b7c5.png] 

Hence,** "UJSTIEC"** is the correct answer.
